items.label: Research Theme 01
items.title: Plasmonic Nanostructures & SERS Biosensors
items.description: We design and fabricate cost-effective, large-area plasmonic substrates—such as convective self-assembled nanoparticles, metallic nanogaps, and porous biomaterials (silk fibroin, nitrocellulose, chitosan)—to achieve ultra-sensitive Surface-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy (SERS) and Localized Surface Plasmon Resonance (LSPR) detection of disease biomarkers, glucose, and pathogens.

items.label: Research Theme 02
items.title: Fiber-Optic & Miniaturized Point-of-Care Optical Systems
items.description: To translate optical spectroscopy from the benchtop to clinical and field settings, we develop hollow-core fiber SERS probes, 3D-printed multimodal Raman probes, and portable optical readers capable of rapid, label-free molecular diagnosis with high signal-to-noise ratios.

items.label: Research Theme 03
items.title: Optical Neuromodulation & Wearable Biomedical Devices
items.description: We explore near-infrared photothermal neural stimulation mediated by gold nanorods as well as flexible, sustainable wearable sensors—including upcycled chitosan-based electronic skin, digital stethoscopes, and pulse oximetry imaging systems—for continuous physiological monitoring and human–machine interfaces.
